scope: Read-only review of two actual source snapshots using complete installed workflow packages; no engine execution or new editor/device acquisition.

project_one.name: Shape Company
project_one.disposition: Keep combined. Shared scene and run lifetime fit one-screen game; consolidate price presentation without extracting a shop scene.

project_two.name: Small two-target workflow fixture
project_two.disposition: Keep compact Main/Enemy split; resolve the broad background mouse action if mouse interaction is intended through named controls.

parent_comparison.evidence: Fresh fork_turns=none Sol dispatch used neutral labels and raw source; no expected findings, prior report or private criteria in dispatch. Packaged workflow teaching examples remain an explicit limitation.
Both project entries identify owners, named methods/consumers, a concrete change trace and an explicit disposition.
Project one traces UNIT_PRICE vs literal 3g messages/buttons; recommends consolidating runtime price presentation while keeping scene/controller arrangement.
Project two keeps its compact Main/Enemy split and explicitly rejects added managers/scenes without a demonstrated benefit.
Advisory price/input concerns are distinct from architecture. Source tests are not labeled fresh passes or proof of saved editor state.
Report explicitly declares no engine/editor/device execution and marks excluded acquisition evidence unavailable in this packet.

workflow_findings.title: Source-only review routing is implicit
workflow_findings.status: recorded, not repaired in this evaluation
workflow_findings.assessment: Supported: entrypoints direct native checks/acquisition, while review.md provides selective lenses without an explicit source-only evidence-labeling branch. Reviewer resolved scope correctly from the dispatch.

additional_finding_disposition.finding: Project two unhandled left click always hits left
additional_finding_disposition.assessment: Source behavior verified. Reviewer appropriately made correction conditional on intended controls; no requirement establishes that this calibration fallback is forbidden. Do not promote to a demonstrated defect or alter the fixture on this evidence alone.

limits: One reviewer and two projects do not establish general reliability.

The workflow itself contains teaching examples derived from the pilot; source copies and task prompt are blinded to earlier verdicts, but the pilot is a regression case rather than a wholly unseen generalization case.
Source review forward-test; no new editor or real-device certification implied.
These projects exercise a supported maintainability concern and a legitimate compact design; they do not establish sensitivity to every kind of overloaded controller.
Fresh runtime evidence was excluded by the evaluation scope; prior pilot/editor/device evidence has not been invalidated.
